page_title: Order of the National Hero of Georgia
name_original: Order of the National Hero of Georgia
grade_material_clues: Order of the National Hero of Georgia    GEO001   ეროვნული გმირის ორდენი      Order is instituted on 24 June 2004 as the highest honor awarded by the government of Georgia together with the title of National Hero.   Order is awarded for outstanding and heroic service for the benefit of Georgia.                    Georgia

St. George's Order of Victory    GEO002   წმინდა გიორგის სახელობის გამარჯვების ორდენი      Order is instituted on 24 June 2004.   Order is awarded to Georgian and foreign nationals for an exceptional role played in victories for Georgia.                    Georgia

Order of David The Builder    GEO003   დავით აღმაშენებლის ორდენი      Order was instituted on 24 December 1992. Order is also known as the David Agmashenebeli Order.   Order is awarded to civilians, military and clergymen for significant work for the benefit of Georgia, independence, democracy and social consolidation.    David IV of Georgia  - was a king of Georgia.                    Georgia

Order of Queen Tamara    GEO004   თამარ მეფის ორდენი      Order is instituted on 31 July 2009.   Order is awarded to women for outstanding services to the people and fatherland.    Tamar of Georgia  - reigned as the Queen of Georgia.                        Georgia

Presidential Order of Excellence    GEO005   ბრწყინვალების საპრეზიდენტო ორდენი      Order is instituted on 31 July 2009.   Order is awarded for significant achievements in the fields of culture, education, science, art, sport, and other.                        Georgia

Order of St. Nicholas    GEO006   წმინდა ნიკოლოზის ორდენი      Order is instituted on 31 July 2009.   Order is awarded for outstanding charitable or social activities in free service to the country and the people.                        Georgia

Order of the Golden Fleece    GEO007   ოქროს საწმისის ორდენი      Order was instituted on 26 June 1998.   Order is awarded to individuals with foreign citizenship and those holding no citizenship who have significantly contributed to Georgia's governmental improvement, national security interests, sovereignty and protection of territorial unity, formation of democratic and free society, development of useful bilateral relationships with foreign countries and international organizations, protection of rights of Georgian citizens living abroad, popularization of Georgian culture, and development of Georgian science and art.                    Georgia

Order of Vakhtang Gorgasali    GEO008   ვახტანგ გორგასლის ორდენი      Order was instituted on 24 December 1992.   Order is awarded to military personnel who displayed courage and heroism in fighting for and protecting the motherland and its territorial unification, while skillfully leading their troops and creating and carrying out successful military operations.   Order is awarded in three classes.    Vakhtang I of Iberia  - was a king of Iberia.                                                        Georgia

Order of Honour    GEO009   ღირსების ორდენი      Order was instituted on 24 December 1992.   Order is awarded to citizens who took part in the building process of an independent government – devoted themselves, displayed heroism and actively participated in approving and sustaining the following – governing, defense, law and order, farming, health protection, achievement in the fields of science, education, culture, literature, art and sports.                                    Georgia

Medal For Civil Sacrifice    GEO013   მედალი სამოქალქო თავდადებისათვის      Medal was instituted on 18 June 2020.   Medal is awarded to Georgian citizens for selfless civic actions, for the manifestation of special civic responsibility and personal courage.                    Georgia

Medal of Military Valour    GEO010   მედალი მხედრული მამაცობისათვის      Medal was instituted on 24 December 1992.   Medal is awarded to military and police personnel for protecting their Motherland while displaying bravery and courage when carrying out military duties, for heroic and daring actions.                                Georgia

Medal of Military Honour    GEO011   მედალი საბრძოლო დამსახურებისათვის      Medal was instituted on 24 December 1992.   Medal is awarded to military personnel and citizens who actively participated in the protection of their Motherland and its territorial unity.                                Georgia

Medal of Honour    GEO012   ღირსების მედალი      Medal was instituted on 24 December 1992.   Medal is awarded to Georgian citizens who actively participated in the revival of Georgia and devoted themselves to noble deeds.                            Georgia

name_original: Ministry of the Interior Medal of Bravery
grade_material_clues: Ministry of the Interior Medal of Bravery    GEO014   მედლით მამაცობისათვის      Medal was instituted on 7 July 2008.   Medal is awarded to employees of the Ministry of the Interior and other persons who have shown particular courage and dedication in the fight against crime.                            Georgia

page_title: Ministry of the Interior Distinguished Service Medal
name_original: Ministry of the Interior Distinguished Service Medal
grade_material_clues: Ministry of the Interior Distinguished Service Medal    GEO015   მედალი განსაკუთრებული დამსახურებისათვის      Medal is instituted on 7 December 2011.   Medal is awarded to employees of the Ministry of the Interior for special contribution to the effective solution of the tasks facing the Ministry of the Interior, as well as citizens of Georgia, foreign citizens and other persons who made a special contribution to the fight against crime.   Medal is awarded in two classes.                    Georgia

page_title: Ministry of the Interior Medal For Impeccable Service
name_original: Ministry of the Interior Medal For Impeccable Service
grade_material_clues: Ministry of the Interior Medal For Impeccable Service    GEO016   მედალი უმწიკლო სამსახურისთვის      Medal was instituted on 24 December 1992.   Medal was awarded to employees of the Ministry of the Interior for long and good service.   Medal was awarded in three classes: for 10 years, 15 years, and 20 years of service.   Medal was abolished in 2008.                                        Georgia

page_title: Ministry of Defense Medal For Impeccable Service
name_original: Ministry of Defense Medal For Impeccable Service
grade_material_clues: Ministry of Defense Medal For Impeccable Service    GEO017   მედალი ,,საქართველოს თავდაცვის სამინისტროს სისტემაში უმწიკვლო სამსახურისათვის“       Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to servicemen of the Ministry of Defense of Georgia for long and good service. page_title: Medal for Devotion to the Motherland
name_original: Medal for Devotion to the Motherland
grade_material_clues: Medal for Devotion to the Motherland    GEO018   მედალი «სამშობლოსათვის თავდადებული»      Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to servicemen of the Ministry of Defense of Georgia for outstanding services in strengthening the country's defense capability both in wartime and in peacetime.                    Georgia

Medal Kakutsa Cholokashvili    GEO019   მედ­ლით ქა­ქუ­ცა ჩო­ლო­ყაშ­ვი­ლი      Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to servicemen of the Ministry of Defense of Georgia for outstanding services in the restoration and protection of the territorial integrity of Georgia.    Kakutsa Cholokashvili  - was a Georgian military officer.                        Georgia

Medal General Kvinitadze    GEO020   მედალი «გენერალი კვინიტაძე»      Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to officers of the Joint Staff of the Georgian Armed Forces and its structural divisions, officers of the command and staff of the Armed Forces, commanders of brigades and battalions of the Armed Forces for maintain high combat readiness of troops.    Giorgi Kvinitadze  - was a Georgian military commander.                    Georgia

Lifesaving Medal    GEO021   მედალი «სიცოცხლის გადარჩენისათვის»      Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to servicemen of the Armed Forces for saving human life both in wartime and in peacetime.                 Georgia

Medal For Peacekeeping Operations    GEO022   მედალი «სამშვიდობო ოპერაციებში მონაწილეობისათვის»      Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to servicemen of the Armed Forces for impeccable service in operations to maintain and restore international peace and security, as well as in other peacekeeping activities.                                 Georgia

Medal General Mazniashvili    GEO023   მედ­ლით გე­ნე­რა­ლი მაზ­ნი­აშ­ვი­ლი      Medal is instituted on 10 February 2006.   Medal is awarded to staff officers of the Armed Forces for successful planning of military operations and high professionalism.     Giorgi Mazniashvili  - was a Georgian general.                        Georgia

Georgia
